description: This implementation uses the MLCommons Storage v2.0 reference code with Alluxio 3.6.0 mounted in FUSE mode pointing to AWS S3. System config: 8 clients, 8 servers, 128 total accelerators.
run_command: mlpstorage training run --hosts 127.0.0.1 --num-client-hosts 8 --client-host-memory-in-gb 100 --num-accelerators 128 --accelerator-type H100 --model resnet50  --data-dir /mnt/alluxio/alluxio-fuse/s3/resnet50_29942_3999GB --results-dir /home/ubuntu/mlps_results  --param dataset.num_files_train=29942  --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe
